A little about my approach

Design judgment.
Technical understanding.

I’m a product designer based in Norfolk, Virginia, with a background in information technology and web development. My work spans financial services, government resources, and commerce, with a focus on making complex systems easier to navigate.

I connect research, interaction design, and technical understanding to move ideas toward working experiences. That means considering the full journey: what people need, how a system behaves, and what happens when something goes wrong.

I work with engineering, content, operations, and external partners to turn those decisions into coherent experiences. My approach is grounded in clear language, accessible interactions, and collaboration throughout delivery.

B.S. in Information Technology, focused in Web Development
